query:
query MyConnectedAccounts {
  myConnectedAccounts {
    id
    handle
    provider
    authFailedAt
    authFailedReason
    archivedAt
    scopes
    handleAliases
    lastSignedInAt
    userWorkspaceId
    connectionProviderId
    applicationId
    name
    scope
    lastCredentialsRefreshedAt
    connectionParameters {
      IMAP {
        host
        port
        connectionSecurity
        username
        __typename
      }
      SMTP {
        host
        port
        connectionSecurity
        username
        __typename
      }
      CALDAV {
        host
        username
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    __typename
  }
}
